## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Validation

List the commands or checks used to validate the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated modifications.
- [ ] Release build passes with warnings treated as errors.
- [ ] All deterministic tests pass.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] Public variable changes are intentional and documented.
- [ ] Provider process cleanup behavior is preserved.
- [ ] Tests do not require authenticated provider CLI sessions.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when public behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, cookies, or private account information are included.
